about.title: About The Event
about.imdDesc: The apex commercial exhibition showcasing Controlled Environment Agriculture (CEA) climate chambers, automated bulk composting plants, cutting-edge machinery, and certified spawn biotechnology.
about.shroomDesc: The premier deal-making summit uniting growers directly with supermarket procurement heads, HoReCa distributors, freeze-drying processors, and National Horticulture Board subsidy advisors.

industryChain.title: Industry Chain & Species
industryChain.buttonSubheading: India's highest-volume commercial mushroom powering nationwide wholesale markets, modern retail, and processing industries.
industryChain.buttonPoint1Desc: Multi-tier aluminum shelving, automated climate computers & humidity controls.
industryChain.buttonPoint2Desc: Bunker fermentation, automated tunnel pasteurization & specialized turning.
industryChain.buttonPoint3Desc: High-yielding sterile master cultures with maximum biological efficiency.
industryChain.specialtySubheading: Explore high-margin specialty mushrooms transforming Indian agriculture through agro-waste valorization and medicinal extracts.

whyJoin.title: Why India Mushroom Days
whyJoin.r1Subtitle: Direct access to high-volume market channels
whyJoin.r1Desc: Position your brand at the center of India's surging edible and medicinal mushroom revolution. Expand wholesale distribution pipelines, contract farming agreements, and international buyer linkages.
whyJoin.r2Desc: Inspect live cutting-edge Controlled Environment Agriculture (CEA) climate computers, multi-tier shelving infrastructure, compost turning machinery, and automated spawn bagging technologies.
whyJoin.r3Desc: Network with verified global equipment manufacturers from the Netherlands, China, and Europe alongside top Indian farm operators, substrate suppliers, and cold-chain logistics providers.
whyJoin.r4Desc: Gain proprietary technical masterclass insights from leading mycology scientists, spawn laboratory geneticists, substrate composting researchers, and medicinal extract formulators.
whyJoin.r5Desc: A dedicated procurement conclave putting progressive growers face-to-face with retail supermarket category heads, freeze-drying processors, and dietary supplement brands.
whyJoin.r6Subtitle: Government grants, subsidies & project DPR consulting
whyJoin.r6Desc: Access on-the-spot financial advisory from banking institutions and National Horticulture Board (NHB) experts for commercial farm setup and cold-chain modernization subsidies.
